headline: Sensex gains over 400 points as Nifty crosses 25,200 driven by FII inflows and lower crude oil prices.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows driven market sentiment.
Lower crude oil prices providing relief to equities.
Positive long-term projections by Morgan Stanley targeting Sensex at 95,000 by Dec 2027.
Rally led by top gainers such as Asian Paints and Bharti Airtel.
whatHappening: Sensex rose by over 400 points while Nifty 50 traded above the 25,200 level.
Kaynes Technology shares dropped sharply by up to 15% in early trade.
Natco Pharma rallied up to 9% despite reporting weak Q2 results.
Inox Wind share price slipped 10% following the release of its Q2 results.
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened higher on 16 November 2026, with the Sensex gaining over 400 points and Nifty staying above 25,200. Market gains were supported by FII inflows and lower crude oil prices, alongside strength in Asian Paints and Bharti Airtel. Stock-specific action was prominent, as Kaynes Technology and Inox Wind tumbled while Natco Pharma surged despite weak quarterly numbers.
